name: radial-burst
title: Radial Burst
description: A dot launches rounded ribbons that curl into a ring, spin shut and sweep out of frame in a bold geometric burst.
useWhen: A logo sting, section opener or hard transition needs one bold geometric gesture.
You want a colorful, self-contained abstract shape moment with a clean exit.
avoidWhen: The shape should stay on screen: it sweeps out of frame by the end.
A calm, minimal reveal is needed.
author: Remocn
